name: higher-order
description: Mandatory PAUSE, SUCCESS, and task routing plus focused skills for decisions, architecture, writing, and product judgment.

interface.shortDescription: Selective skills for clearer assignments, decisions, plans, designs, and architecture.
interface.longDescription: Higher Order packages reusable Codex skills for better agent work: probing vague prompts, defining completion, routing tasks by complexity, comparing meaningful alternatives, writing implementation-ready guidance, and connecting UI design taste with project architecture taste.
defaultPrompt: Probe this app idea before implementing. Ask only the questions that would change the build.
Restate what you think I want, name your assumptions, then propose the smallest useful first version.
Before coding, define what production-ready means for this project and what you are intentionally not building.
